simple.summary: הָם (Hâm) means Ham , a region of Palestine First listed occurrence: Gen 14 5.

definitions.full: H1990. Ham הָ֑ם proper name, of a location only in בְּהָ֑ם הַזּוּזִים Gen 14:5 ; not otherwise known; Vrss בָּהֶם ; Jer Quaest. in libr. Genes. בְּחֹם ; Ol conjectures בַּחֲמָת ; Tu Di think perhaps old name of Rabbath Ammon.
